sections.heading: Understanding The Science of 432Hz Tuning and Cellular Resonance
sections.content: The journey into sound healing & frequencies reveals profound connections between human biology and expanded states of awareness. sections.heading: Daily Practical Protocol
sections.content:
1. Begin with 5 minutes of rhythmic diaphragmatic breathing.
2. Engage your physical anchor (sound, posture cushion, or focal object).
3. Maintain soft gaze or closed eyes, focusing on subtle internal vibrations.
4. Close with 3 minutes of silent gratitude.
